parameters.jsCode:
const data = $json;
const role = data.role ?? {};
const requester = data.requester ?? {};
const submittedBy = data.submittedBy ?? {};
const setup = data.recruitmentSetup ?? {};
const text = (value) => String(value ?? '');
const list = (value) => Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter(Boolean).join('\n') : text(value);

return [{
  json: {
    Role_ID: text(data.roleId),
    Request_Type: text(role.requestType),
    Department: text(role.department),
    Job_Title: text(role.jobTitle),
    Number_Of_Vacancies: Number(role.numberOfVacancies || 0),
    Reason_For_Request: text(role.reasonForRequest),
    Replacement_Employee: text(role.replacementEmployee),
    Target_Hiring_Date: text(role.targetHiringDate),
    Reporting_Manager: text(role.reportingManager),
    Work_Location: text(role.workLocation),
    Employment_Type: text(role.employmentType),
    Job_Responsibilities: text(role.jobResponsibilities),
    Required_Skills: text(role.requiredSkills),
    Experience_Required: text(role.experienceRequired),
    Education_Requirements: text(role.educationRequirements),
    Preferred_Qualifications: text(role.preferredQualifications),
    Role_Expectations: text(role.roleExpectations),
    Salary_Min: role.salaryMin ?? '',
    Salary_Max: role.salaryMax ?? '',
    Work_Schedule: text(role.workSchedule),
    Created_At: text(data.createdAt),
    Status: text(data.status || 'Pending HR Discussion'),
    Last_Updated_At: text(data.updatedAt || data.createdAt),
    Last_Updated_By_Name: text(submittedBy.name),
    Last_Updated_By_Email: text(submittedBy.email).toLowerCase(),
    Latest_Comments: text(data.Latest_Comments ?? data.workflowFields?.Latest_Comments),
    Resume_Target_Status: text(data.Resume_Target_Status ?? data.workflowFields?.Resume_Target_Status),
    Notification_Status: 'pending',
    Notification_Error: '',
    Management_Comments: '',
    Approved_By: '',
    Approved_At: '',
    Job_Description: text(role.jobDescription),
    Screening_Criteria: text(setup.screeningCriteria),
    Initial_Interview_Questions: list(setup.initialInterviewQuestions),
    AI_Interviewer_Name: text(setup.aiInterviewerName),
    AI_Interviewer_Behavior: text(setup.aiInterviewerBehavior),
    Required_Interview_Question_1: text(setup.requiredInterviewQuestion1),
    Required_Interview_Question_2: text(setup.requiredInterviewQuestion2),
    Required_Interview_Question_3: text(setup.requiredInterviewQuestion3),
    Final_AI_Evaluation_Template: text(setup.finalAiEvaluationTemplate),
    AI_System_Prompt: text(setup.aiSystemPrompt),
    Initial_Interview_Booking_Link: text(setup.initialInterviewBookingLink),
    HOD_Interview_Booking_Link: text(setup.hodInterviewBookingLink),
    Posting_Channels: list(setup.postingChannels),
    Recruitment_Setup_Updated_At: '',
    Recruitment_Setup_Updated_By_Name: '',
    Recruitment_Setup_Updated_By_Email: '',
    Requester_Name: text(requester.name),
    Requester_Email: text(requester.email).toLowerCase(),
    Requester_Type: text(requester.type),
    Submitted_By_Name: text(submittedBy.name),
    Submitted_By_Email: text(submittedBy.email).toLowerCase(),
    Submission_ID: text(data.submissionId),
    Source: text(data.source || 'Role Creation Website'),
    Action_Request_ID: text(data.actionRequestId || data.submissionId),
    License_or_Certificate_Required: text(setup.licenseOrCertificateRequired),
    Keywords_to_Look_For: text(setup.keywordsToLookFor),
    Minimum_Years_of_Experience: setup.minimumYearsOfExperience ?? '',
    Transferable_Skills_Accepted: text(setup.transferableSkillsAccepted),
    Salary_or_Budget_Range: text(setup.salaryOrBudgetRange),
    Earliest_Availability_Rule: text(setup.earliestAvailabilityRule),
    Interview_Behavior: text(setup.interviewBehavior),
    HOD_Availability_Dates: text(role.hodAvailabilityDates),
    HOD_Availability_Times: text(role.hodAvailabilityTimes),
    Custom_Screening_Question_1: text(role.customScreeningQuestion1),
    Custom_Screening_Question_2: text(role.customScreeningQuestion2),
    AI_Screening_Questions: list(role.aiGeneratedScreeningQuestions),
    Notice_Period_Requirement: text(role.noticePeriodRequirement),
    Salary_Expectation_Guidance: text(role.salaryExpectationGuidance),
    Recruitment_Setup_Status: text(setup.recruitmentSetupStatus || 'Draft'),
    Salary_Disclosure_Status: text(setup.salaryDisclosureStatus),
    Experience_Requirement_Status: text(setup.experienceRequirementStatus),
    License_Requirement_Status: text(setup.licenseRequirementStatus),
    HOD_Interview_Required: text(setup.hodInterviewRequired),
    Recruitment_Ready_At: '',
    Recruitment_Ready_By: '',
    Ready_For_Publishing_At: '',
    Ready_For_Publishing_By: '',
    Application_Link: '',
    Posting_Confirmed: 'FALSE',
    Posted_At: '',
    Posted_By: ''
  }
}];
